reels.title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient

editorial_notes.reasoning: Velox addresses 'World Models' and visual memory, which are high-fascination topics for AI enthusiasts. The 0.91x velocity is offset by its strong potential for 'streaming' visual metaphors.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How does an AI 'remember' what it just saw in a video without crashing your GPU memory?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A photographer who only keeps the 'edges' of a scene to reconstruct the whole image instead of storing the entire raw film roll.
